datasets.name: Dscontracts
datasets.sql:
select a.rowid,a.id, iit.name contr_type, a.begin_date, a.end_date, (a.ammount+nvl((select sum(ammount) from ins_invest_payment where cid=a.id),0)) as ammount,a.percent,
(select name from filial where id=a.filial)as filial,
(select acc_no from account where id=a.main_acc_id) as main_acc_id,(select acc_no from account where id=a.income_acc_id) as income_acc_no,
(select acc_no from account where id=a.exp_acc_id) as exp_acc_no,a.income_acc_id,a.exp_acc_id,
(select acc_no from account where id=a.per_acc_id)  as per_acc_id,a.per_ammount,round((a.per_ammount/360),2) as Calc_day_per,
round((a.per_ammount/360)*10/100,2) as omv,(round((a.per_ammount/360),2)-round((a.per_ammount/360)*10/100,2)) as remainder_per_ammount,
cust.name as musteri, a.contract_name,ii.name as muddetli,av.val_name,a.status,(select abs(ostat) from tenostat where acc_id=a.main_acc_id) as esas_qaliq,
(select ostat from tenostat where acc_id=a.per_acc_id) as faiz_qaliq
from ins_investment_contracts a,ins_investment_type iit,ins_investment_time ii,customers cust,avalute av
where a.invest_type_id=iit.id and a.kli_id=cust.id and a.invest_time=ii.id and a.valute_id=av.valute and a.id=:cid

datasets.name: DsMain
datasets.sql:
select a.id,a.cid,a.ammount,a.dat,ic.contract_name from ins_invest_trans a,ins_investment_contracts ic 
where a.cid=ic.id 
and a.cid=:pcid
order by a.id desc
